blockers.where: listen density / verify onsets vs water density
blockers.wanted: confirm dense bubble onsets at high bubble density
blockers.tried: water density 300 / 900 / 3000: default-spacing onset detector gave 44 / 24 / 8 events/s (inverted: denser bubbles merge into a continuous texture); only verify onsets with spacing_ms 5 gives a stable count (161 at the final setting)
blockers.workaround: chose a mid density (~420 bubbles/s at flow 0.5 via the busyness macro at 0.2) and checked with onsets spacing_ms 5

blockers.wanted: hp/lp after a periodic water loop without breaking the seam
blockers.tried: water loop:true then filter hp 250 and lp 7000: loop_seam FAIL 3.1x (filter state starts cold at the wrap)
blockers.workaround: crossfade_loop fade 0.25 at the end of the chain (seam 0.39x, spectral 2.1 dB)

blockers.wanted: slowly varying flow in a loop
blockers.tried: wander (fields rate/range, not min/max) is not periodic, so I kept flow constant
blockers.workaround: constant flow 0.5; variation comes from the bubble randomness

wishlist: a periodic (loop-safe) slow modulator for control signals such as flow
verify onsets that defaults to a dense-event detector for loops / a density check expect
claim measure for event density so a busyness macro can be swept
what_worked: water node gave bubbles plus hiss in one node, loop:true default seam-clean
macros with claims centroid +/-1 passed on first try
